review.posthog_relevance: Adds exception handling and kill-switch support for ClickHouse byte limits, potentially improving reliability and preventing classification of transient database errors.
review.reason: Adds a dedicated exception class and imports kill-switch configuration helpers, establishing the necessary exception hierarchy and state checks for handling ClickHouse byte limit errors. However, the actual implementation of the exception, the budget calculation, and the wrapping helper are not present in this chunk, so the tier is capped at 2.
